description: This file contains JUnit test cases for testing content management functionalities, including static content files and images in the Shopizer e-commerce platform. It tests adding, retrieving, and deleting static files and images through the ContentService.

classes.name: StaticContentTestCase
classes.description: JUnit test class for static content management including images and ZIP files within the Shopizer platform.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Tests uploading, retrieving, and deleting an image file in static content.

methods.name: testCreateStaticContent
methods.description: Tests uploading and optionally retrieving a ZIP static content file.

methods.name: testCreateMultipleStaticContent
methods.description: Tests uploading multiple static files in a batch operation.
